title: Scopes module guards and invokes its own extension inputs (D22)
summary: The module stops using core internals: module-internal `Scopes\Internal\Query\FilterQuery`/`FilterGuard` replace `PredicateBuilder`/`QueryGuard` for filters and access adapters, closure filters are invoked positionally with a compile-time signature check instead of `RuntimeInvoker`, `Narrow` calls become explicit checks, and `QueryScopeDirectory` keeps the `ModelLookup` behavior privately. All i4.json entries of `EligibilityBuilder.php` and `QueryScopeDirectory.php` disappear.
why: I4: a module uses only attributed core symbols; `PredicateBuilder`/`QueryGuard` stay core internals used by ResourceContextMapping and the Relation adapter. Hard risk: the module guard must refuse exactly what the core guard refuses (destructive calls, replacement query, terminal results, non-where shape changes); a weaker copy would let a filter broaden or mutate — parity and negative tests prove equality.

include: New `AzGuard\Scopes\Internal\Query\FilterQuery` and `AzGuard\Scopes\Internal\Query\FilterGuard` (oracle rows by #oracle) with the semantics of knowledge/p3-execution#module-guard; `Scopes\Query\EligibilityBuilder::apply/constrain/shape/validateShape` use them

Closure filters invoked as `($query, $runtime)`; module `ScopeConfiguration::filters()` rejects other closure signatures (DefinitionException naming the alias); `Policies\RuntimeInvoker` no longer referenced by module files
`Kernel\Support\Narrow` no longer referenced by module files; `Directories\QueryScopeDirectory` (module-owned) implements `ModelLookup::match/label` behavior as private methods
i4.json: every entry with file `EligibilityBuilder.php` or `QueryScopeDirectory.php` removed
Negative tests per #module-guard; migration line for name-injected filter closures
exclude: A public guarded-query SPI (D22 option B rejected)

rules: After this item `git grep -nE 'PredicateBuilder|QueryGuard|RuntimeInvoker|Narrow::|ModelLookup' packages/core/src/Scopes packages/core/src/Directories/QueryScopeDirectory.php` matches nothing.
Existing filter/adapter/visibility tests stay green unchanged except tests of name-injected closures, which are rewritten to the positional form plus one negative test.

result.notes: FilterQuery/FilterGuard replace PredicateBuilder/QueryGuard/PredicateQuery inside the Scopes module; closure filters are ($query, $runtime) only (D22); QueryScopeDirectory keeps its own label/match/search helpers. V1-V6 green incl. composer test 4753.
